formulas.ascii: Among reference rows J strictly within squared tolerance t^2 of p, choose the lexicographic minimum (squared distance, reference row). Output that reference position, or retain p and report NO_REFERENCE when no candidate exists. J is the whole reference set or the matching feature range; t=max(parameters[0],0).
